audit.whatIsWrong: The content chart handed Volibear levels 2 through first item while every one of those why-strings says the opposite ('out-chips his W bite-heal', 'pull your sustain ahead of his bite', 'a full kill combo', 'force every all-in in this window'), and win[6] said Skill where whys[6] says 'He out-scales you'.
audit.why: Win rate is 60.13% over 301 games — this is a strongly Gragas-favoured lane, and packet.levelChart reads Skill / Gragas / Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Volibear, matching the prose on both layers.
audit.corrected: Both charts flipped as one atomic group to Skill / Gragas / Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Volibear with ratings raised to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike and phase text repeatedly described Sky Splitter (E) as a 'leap-stun' and an 'E leap', and called his Q engage 'unstoppable'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Sky Splitter is 'summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius' — 1200 range, 16s, no leap and no stun. The leap is Stormbringer (R), 550 range, 160/135/110s, which grants bonus health and disables nearby towers. Nothing in Riot's text makes Thundering Smash unstoppable.
audit.corrected: Sky Splitter now described as a ranged bolt that shields and slows; the leap attributed to R with its 160s cooldown; the unstoppable claim removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thundering Smash was called a 'root' in whys[2], whys[4], early, mid, wants.you[2] and wants.foe[0]. It is a stun, and crucially it only lands on the first enemy he attacks — a minion can absorb it. Ranges and cooldowns were absent throughout the full layer.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks' — 300 range, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10. Frenzied Maul is 5s and heals him on a second cast on the same target. Barrel Roll reaches 850 and Body Slam 600, both far outside his 300.
audit.corrected: Stun wording, the first-target-only quirk, and the 300/850/600 range gap written into whys, wants, early, mid, tradeGood, dosFull, dontsFull, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried placeholders and no numbers.
audit.why: Q at 12s, W at 5s and R at 160s are the three timers this lane runs on.
Early Executioner's Calling is already prescribed and is right — Frenzied Maul heals him on every second cast on the same target, on a 5-second cooldown.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now states the 5s/second-cast mechanic instead of generic filler.

edits.before: Volibear's W bite heals and slows, but at level 1 he has no engage tool up and you have no ability cast to proc Happy Hour either, so it is even on minion damage. The moment you have Q+W at 2, a Drunken Rage empowered auto plus the Happy Hour heal out-chips his bite-heal — step up and trade. Watch his Q (Thundering Smash): if he starts rushing you mid-trade he is looking to root you and follow with an E leap, so keep Body Slam (E) held to disengage rather than burning it to chase a minion.
edits.after: Volibear's W bite heals and slows, but at level 1 he has no engage tool up and you have no ability cast to proc Happy Hour either, so it is even on minion damage. The moment you have Q+W at 2, a Drunken Rage empowered auto plus the Happy Hour heal out-chips his bite-heal — step up and trade. Watch his Q (Thundering Smash): 300 range, 12s at rank 1, and it stuns only the first enemy he attacks, so hold Body Slam (E) to disengage the stun rather than burning it to chase a minion.

edits.before: This is your window. With W max and Happy Hour you out-sustain his bite, and the damage reduction from Drunken Rage blunts his empowered autos during the brawl. At 6 your E-W-Q is a genuine kill threat: bait or sidestep his Q root, then E in, drink-empower the auto, and detonate the cask. Save Explosive Cask to knock him away from his wave or into your tower so he cannot land the Q-into-E all-in he wants — and never trade into him after his Q roots you, because the E leap and bite follow instantly.
edits.after: This is your window. With W max and Happy Hour you out-sustain his bite, and the damage reduction from Drunken Rage blunts his empowered autos during the brawl. At 6 your E-W-Q is a genuine kill threat: let a minion eat his Q stun, then E in, drink-empower the auto, and detonate the cask. Save Explosive Cask to knock him away from his wave or into your tower — and never keep trading once he has stunned you, because Sky Splitter's slow and the bite follow instantly.

notes: Both suspectNames ('Use Explosive Cask', 'Save Explosive Cask') are FALSE POSITIVES — the matcher caught the verb, not a wrong name. The substantive naming error was elsewhere and is fixed here: Sky Splitter (E) was repeatedly described as a leap-stun when it is a 1200-range lightning bolt that slows and shields him, and Thundering Smash (Q) was called a root when it is a stun that only lands on the first enemy he attacks. Not asserted for lack of source: whether Volibear's R leap can be interrupted or displaced by Explosive Cask mid-flight, and whether Thundering Smash's stun is reduced by Tenacity — neither is in Riot's text.
